description: Build and design Backend REST API using PHP (CodeIgniter), then integrate it with AngularJS frontend and implement responsive UI using Tailwind CSS. Develop several enterprise information systems including police resource management, education management systems, and a gym management application.

Develop an information system that manages construction projects within PT. Al-Azhar Bandung. Responsible for designing the database, developing backend services using Laravel, implementing frontend features, and managing project workflow and monitoring.

Develop an AI-powered Smart CCTV information system for public transportation. Build the frontend dashboard using React.js and integrate it with Flask backend APIs. The system monitors bus conditions by detecting driver distraction, recognizing the driver's face, counting passengers, and displaying real-time monitoring results.

Develop and design frontend interfaces using React.js, then integrate them with Blockchain APIs. The application is an NFT Marketplace that enables digital asset transactions using Web3 and Cryptocurrency technologies with responsive and modern user interfaces.
